title: The trial of Demonic Saint Huang Quan
summary: Yao Ming is chief of the Nine Serene Deep Ground Pythons again, and Xiao Yan has the Spring Blood Crystal. Yao Ming shows him the secret stone tablet of Demonic Saint Huang Quan, an ancient Yellow Spring Great Saint who nearly became a Dou Di. Only a soul in the Heavenly Realm can enter it, so Yao Ming asks Xiao Yan to go in, offering to share the saint's essence blood and three Tian Class Dou Skills. Inside, Xiao Yan faces the Yellow Spring Finger, the Yellow Spring Palm and finally the saint's remnant, a peak Nine-Star Dou Sheng. He survives the Yellow Spring Divine Anger by forcing out his Heavenly Flame and drawing on the Bodhisattva Heart. Huang Quan accepts him and gives him his essence blood and inheritance. He asks Xiao Yan to find what he lacked to become a Dou Di.
events: Yao Ming takes back control and keeps Elders Ming, Xian and Liu close.
Xiao Yan confirms he has the Spring Blood Crystal; Yao Ming calls him a friend.
A flashback shows young Yao Ming and Yao Xiaotian racing as brothers.
Yao Ming reveals Demonic Saint Huang Quan's stone tablet and its secrets.
He offers essence blood and three Tian Class Dou Skills if Xiao Yan opens it.
Inside the tablet Xiao Yan fights through the Yellow Spring Finger and Yellow Spring Palm.
Huang Quan's remnant attacks him with the Yellow Spring Divine Anger.
Xiao Yan endures it and receives the saint's essence blood and inheritance.
